currentResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Polyadditionen analysieren (LK)
currentResourceLink.description: Polyurethanbildung: Urethanbindung, schematische Kettenbildung und trockene, wärmekontrollierte Reaktionsführung.
currentResourceLink.altText: Lokale Addition einer Isocyanatgruppe R–N=C=O mit einer Hydroxygruppe HO–R′ zur Urethanbindung R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′ ohne Abspaltung. Darunter eine ausdrücklich schematische offene Polymerkette; Symbole für trockene Bedingungen und kontrollierte Reaktionswärme.

scientificAssessment.localReaction: R–N=C=O + HO–R′ → R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′ is a correct local isocyanate/alcohol group addition. It is not a complete monomer-to-polymer formula.
scientificAssessment.valences: NCO: N has R single+C double; C has N/O double bonds. Product carbonyl C has NH/O single bonds and O double bond; NH has R,C,H single bonds; linkage O has C/R′ single bonds. All ordinary displayed valences hold.
scientificAssessment.massBalance: Alcohol H is retained on N; no small molecule is shown leaving. This is correct for the dry urethane main reaction.
scientificAssessment.polymerSemantics: The coloured open chain is explicitly schematic, not an atom-resolved polyurethane repeat formula. Blue/green residues and orange links distinguish polymer orientation from the one local formula. Actual repeated growth requires suitably bifunctional partners (diisocyanate+diol for an ideal linear chain); monofunctional compounds alone cannot make this chain. The generic local groups are not labelled complete diisocyanate/diol molecules. No network, complete conversion, guaranteed material property or radical-chain mechanism is asserted.
scientificAssessment.reactionControl: Crossed droplet + trocken gives dry main-reaction context; no water/CO₂ elimination is depicted. Stirred vessel, thermometer and heat/cooling marks are plausible heat-control cues. Water side-reaction chemistry and numeric NCO/OH balance stay in explanatory/practice context.
